From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>

Subject: MAP & acceptance handover — Novus pilot (staged commitment + evidence)

Elaine —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attaching a first-pass mutual action plan that breaks the pilot into two acceptance waves so procurement, legal, and engineering can sign off without delaying the onboarding. High-level asks in the file:

- Wave A (pilot integration + security review): 3 weeks, SOC2 evidence review, service account provisioning
- Wave B (production orderform + DPA): locked after Wave A acceptance, billing cadence and SSO cutover

Two pragmatic requests for your team to unblock us this week:
1) Confirm the procurement contact who will approve the order form (name + email)
2) Share any internal templates/clauses Novus requires for DPAs or data residency — if you send the procurement checklist we will map items to the acceptance gates.

I've copied Aditya for sequencing on the onboarding plan and Marissa for the commercial milestones. I’ll drop SOC2 evidence summary in a separate PDF for your security reviewer.

Next steps: Once you confirm the procurement contact we’ll convert the MAP to a shared timeline (GSheet) and propose exact dates for Wave A kickoff (targeting the week of 6/29).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with gated milestones)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the plan and for the clear breakdown. Quick answers:
- Procurement lead: Samir Rao (samir@novushealth.com) — I’ve looped him in.
- We have a standard DPA template we prefer; I can drop that to Samir and your legal team.

A couple of constraints from our side that will affect timing:
- SOC2 review needs an internal security sign-off (two reviewers) — typically a 7–10 business day window from when we receive evidence.
- Order forms have to clear our finance ops runbook; they need billing cadence and PO vs invoice preference clarified up front.

If you can send the SOC2 summary and the MAP updated with specific deliverable owners (Redwood vs Novus), we’ll prioritize the review. Proposed Wave A kickoff the week of 6/29 works on our end pending evidence.

Elaine

- Aditya (implementation) will own Wave A integration tasks and the onboarding runbook
- Marissa (legal ops) will shepherd the order form + DPA redline process
- Hannah (CS lead) will maintain acceptance criteria and run the pilot success checklist
- Karthik (contracts) will triage any clauses that require legal-level escalation

Kimberly / Aditya —

Quick reply — Novus requires a PO for any spend > $10k, otherwise invoice terms are fine. For the pilot, our finance team prefers a 30-day net invoice unless we convert to a committed seat contract.

On the DPA: we can start with our template but open to Redwood's standard DPA language; if there are any cross-border data residency requirements we’ll need explicit language. I’ll send the procurement checklist (short) to Marissa by EOD.

Thanks all — Marissa from commercial ops. I pushed an updated MAP into the shared Drive (link above) and incorporated:
- Owners column populated (Redwood: Aditya/Hannah; Novus: Samir/Elaine)
- Firm dates proposed for Wave A kickoff: 2026-06-29 to 2026-07-16 (integration + initial acceptance)
- Wave B (order form + DPA) target window: 2026-07-19 to 2026-07-30; contingent on SOC2 sign-off and PO cadence

Action items for Redwood (to complete by EOD 6/23):
- Final SOC2 evidence packet (Aditya)
- Draft order form with invoice vs PO options (Marissa)
- Redline-ready DPA comparison (Karthik)

Samir / Elaine: once we receive your procurement checklist and DPA template we’ll mark up redlines inline and propose final order form language. If Novus prefers the PO path we’ll add the PO field to the invoice milestone and leave invoice fallback for conversion scenarios.
